text:
I'm excited to announce our latest
LangChain Academy foundation course,
Introduction to Deep Agents.

As you use AI at work or in your daily
life, you're rarely interacting
with an LLM directly.

There's almost always a layer of software
that connects the model
to the real world.
That layer is often a harness.

If you're curious about what a harness is,
why agents need one,

or how you can use
one for your own agents,
this course is for you.

In this course, we'll show you
how to build with Deep Agents,
our open-source agent harness

built in collaboration with
the open-source community.

Deep Agents is built for
long-running tasks.

It handles planning, context management,
and multi-agent orchestration
for complex work like research and coding.

Deep Agents is a model-neutral
and highly configurable.

You can use any
model provider, manage state,

and add human-in-the-loop
when you need it.

Tracing and deployment
also work natively with LangSmith.

We'll explore the four core
capabilities of a harness.

So first, we have execution environments,
including file systems, sandboxes,
and code interpreters.

Second, we have context management,
which helps ensure

the model gets the right information
at the right time.

Third, we have delegation,
which helps agents plan long-running tasks
and work through subagents.

And finally steering,
which keeps humans in the loop
for critical actions.

Along the way, you'll get hands-on
experience with each of these capabilities

in Deep Agents, and learn
how to apply them in your own projects.
I hope to see you in this course!
